what: This is a preferred unit of Brookfield Property Partners, which owns a global portfolio of office buildings, shopping centres, hotels, logistics and residential property. Preferred units pay a fixed distribution and rank ahead of the ordinary units.
customers: Office and retail tenants, hotel guests and residents of its properties; this security is held by income investors.
money: rent from offices and shopping centres
moat: Irreplaceable properties in major cities, managed by Brookfield, whose scale and access to capital support the distributions on securities like this one.
risks: Office property values have fallen sharply since 2020
Consolidated debt is very large relative to the equity beneath these units
Revenue fell about 22% last year as assets were sold
The distribution is at the issuer's discretion and ranks behind all debt
opportunities: A distribution yield far above ordinary property shares
Paid before the ordinary unitholders receive anything
Brookfield has continued to support the entity through the office downturn
watch: Asset sales and debt levels, and whether the preferred distribution keeps being paid.
